name: More
heroIntro: Conversations and reflections from brief surprise stops along the way

comingSoonReflections.title: From Rural America to the Ivy League
comingSoonReflections.summary: Drawing from my conversations with students at the Ivy+ Rural Symposium at Harvard College in October, I discuss what it looks like to be a rural student in the Ivy League, barriers to entry, and how my college peers are helping students in their own hometowns see what they can achieve.

comingSoonReflections.title: Grand Canyon
comingSoonReflections.summary: On my way from Idaho to Arkansas, I discuss what rural education looks like in Grand Canyon National Park, the only national park in the United States that houses a K-12 school district.
